args: Appointment times are stored in UTC and shown in the clinic's time zone.
Each vet sees at most 12 patients a day.
Reminder emails are sent through Postmark from src/mail/postmark.ts.
Pet weights are stored in grams as integers.
Prescriptions must be signed by the vet who wrote them before they print.
